app.name: Viet Anh Class
app.tagline: Leading the classroom with 4DX — Viet Anh School

common.viewingOthersClass: {name}'s class — you are viewing as an administrator
common.viewingClassNoOwner: Class has no homeroom teacher — you are viewing as an administrator

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to enter the classroom app
login.orParent: Parents sign in with the invited email
login.linkSentDesc: Check your email and click the link to sign in.
login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
login.hero: Classroom leadership with 4DX — where every Viet Anh student wins the week, together.
login.sentShort: Link sent, please check your email.

unauthorized.title: Account not yet authorized
unauthorized.message: You are signed in, but your account has not been granted access to anything yet. A school administrator needs to approve it once — usually within the working day. Once approved, press “Check again” and you are in; no need to sign in a second time.
unauthorized.noAdminYet: This school has no administrator in the system yet. Tell whoever sent you the invitation.

class.noClassDesc: Your account is not linked to any class. Please contact an administrator.
class.wigGloss: WIG = Wildly Important Goal — the single most important goal to reach. Lead measure = the daily behavior that drives the WIG.
class.noWigDesc: Set up WIGs & lead measures in the WIG section.
class.winningDesc: The class is on pace for its yearly WIGs — keep it up!
class.losingDesc: Some areas are falling behind — focus on this week's lead measures.
class.noClassTeacher: Your account is not the homeroom teacher of any class. Scoreboard, Attendance, Homework and WIG are all organised by homeroom class, so they are empty until you are assigned one — nothing is broken. If you do lead a class, ask an administrator to assign it to you.
class.noClassParent: Your child is not enrolled in a class, or has just left. Please ask the homeroom teacher or the school office to check.
class.noClassStudent: You are not enrolled in a class yet. Tell your homeroom teacher so they can add you.
class.noClassStaff: This campus has no active classes yet. Create one in Admin, then come back here.
class.noCampusAssigned: Your account is not assigned to a campus yet, so there are no classes to show. Ask an admin to pick a campus for you in Admin → Users. The school does have classes — no need to create them again.
class.scoreHint: Percentage of the class’s YEAR goals completed, within this school year. Different from the “Competition” tab, which counts total actions completed.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.lockedPast: Past days editable by Admin only
attendance.readOnly: You have view-only access to attendance.
attendance.realtimeNote: Tick, then press “Save attendance” — this page does NOT autosave. Changes made on another device do appear here within seconds.
attendance.noStudents: This class has no students yet.
attendance.tickAllHint: Tip: set the whole class to 'Present', then adjust a few, then Save.

roster.title: Class roster
roster.name: Student
roster.noStudents: This class has no students yet.
roster.leaderOnlyOne: Each class has exactly one attendance leader — picking someone else clears the previous one. They can take attendance for the teacher, but only for today.
roster.leaderError: Couldn't change it, please try again.
roster.leaderHint: An attendance leader may mark attendance on behalf of the teacher (today only).
roster.enrollLabel: Add a student to this class (email)
roster.confirmRemove: Remove {name} from this class? Their learning data is kept and can be re-enrolled later.
roster.moodNone: No student has checked in their mood yet.
roster.transferConfirmAdmin: Move {name} to the selected class right now? They leave the current class immediately.
roster.transferPendingBody: The request to move {name} to {class} is waiting for that class to approve. The student stays in this class until then.
roster.incomingTitle: {n} requests to move into this class
roster.incomingHint: Approve and they join this class right away. Until then they stay in their current class — nobody is left in limbo.

studentWig.yearIntro: Set a YEARLY target for each area (only once at the start of the year).
studentWig.weekHint: Quickly generate weekly WIGs + lead measures for all 4 areas so the student can start ticking daily.
studentWig.manageHint: Edit target/unit, delete WIG/lead, remove wrong ticks — no dead-ends for the student.
studentWig.label: Period label
studentWig.confirmDeleteLead: Delete this lead measure and all its ticks? Cannot be undone.
studentWig.confirmDeleteWig: Delete this personal WIG (incl. its weekly WIGs/leads)? Cannot be undone.
studentWig.yearFromClass: This student's yearly goals are derived from the class goals (the class has {n} students). Pick how each area is shared out, then create.
studentWig.needClassYear: The class has no yearly goal yet, so there is nothing to share out. Set the class yearly goals first.
studentWig.goSetClassYear: Go to the class WIG page

admin.title: System administration
admin.name: Name
admin.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this user and all related data? This cannot be undone.
admin.emailsMulti: Emails — one per line (or comma-separated) to invite several at once
admin.screensHint: Click to open each screen of the app.
admin.applyNote: Role + class are applied automatically when the user first signs in.
admin.confirmDeleteGrade: Delete this grade? Only allowed when no class belongs to it.
admin.confirmDeleteCampus: Delete this campus? Only allowed when it has no classes. Consider Archive instead.
admin.confirmDeleteClass: Delete this class? Only allowed when it has no students/WIGs. Consider Archive to keep data.
admin.networkHint: Students can only check in their mood (= marked present) when on the school network. Declare the school's public IP/ranges below.
admin.networkNoneWarn: No network declared → students can currently check in from ANYWHERE. Add the school IP to enable the gate.
admin.confirmDeleteNetwork: Remove this network from the check-in allowlist?
admin.areasHint: Edit label, color, icon and default unit. Applies to the class scoreboard and WIG page.
admin.levelHint: Changing the level seeds the standard grades of the new level (existing grades are kept)
admin.pickLevelFirst: Pick a school level to seed grades
admin.manualGradeHint: Preschool grades are not numbered — add them manually
admin.waitingOnYouHint: They can sign in but cannot reach anything yet — their screen is one notice and a sign-out button. Pick a role and press Set role; they press “Check again” and they are in.
admin.confirmDisable: Disable {name} (currently {role})? They can still sign in but will not reach anything until you grant a role again. The current role is NOT stored anywhere — note it before you press.
admin.gvcnRoleChanged: (current homeroom teacher — role changed, kept as is)
admin.confirmResetArea: Reset this area to its default label, colour and icon?
admin.networkOpenBadge: No network set — anyone can check in
admin.subjectsHint: The school-wide subject catalogue, which class studies which subject, and who teaches what. Subject teachers can only enter grades for subjects assigned to them.
admin.menuHint: Weekly meal menus per campus. Parents and students see them on their own pages.
admin.noUsersFilterHint: Try another tab, or clear the search.
admin.confirmDeleteManyBody: Permanent and cannot be undone. All of their related data goes too.
admin.cannotDeleteClass: Cannot delete: this class still has {wig} WIGs and {hs} students. Deleting the class would delete those too. Use Archive to put it away and keep the data.
admin.restoreViaCampus: Restore the campus to bring it back
admin.grantsHint: Emails already granted a role and class. They land in the right place the first time they sign in with Google.
admin.grantsNoMailWarning: The system does NOT email these people. You must tell them yourself to go to class.vietanh.org and sign in with Google using exactly the email above. A pre-assignment only applies on the FIRST sign-in.
admin.confirmCancelGrant: Cancel the pre-assignment for {email}? They will land as pending-approval when they sign in.
admin.grantsFrozen: The list is locked so nothing changes by accident. Hit “Edit list” to change roles or classes, then save the whole batch at once.
admin.grantsConfirmLeave: {n} edited rows are unsaved. Leave and discard them?

dashboard.placeholder: This section will be completed in the next steps.

wig.parentTooShort: The parent goal is shorter than a full week, so no week fits inside it. Pick a different parent.
wig.weekPickHint: Pick any day — the system takes the whole week containing it.
wig.csNoStudents: This class has no active students yet. Go to “Roster” and enroll them first.
wig.csAllSet: Every student has something to tick in week {week}.
wig.csAllSetNow: They will see it under “My scoreboard”.
wig.csAllSetOther: This is the week you are viewing, not the current week — a student screen only shows the current week's actions.
wig.csMissing: {n} students still have nothing to tick in week {week}. Set one shared goal for the whole class here — a single press gives every student an action that week. You can fine-tune any individual later on their own page.
wig.csCreate: Create actions for the whole class — week {week}
wig.title: WIG & Lead measures
wig.confirmDeleteWig: Delete this WIG and all its weekly WIGs / lead measures / progress? This cannot be undone.
wig.confirmDeleteLead: Delete this lead measure and all its logged progress? This cannot be undone.
wig.noWigs: No yearly WIGs yet — create one above.
wig.leadHint: The weekly action that drives the goal above
wig.subCatHint: Optional. The {area} area is already inherited from the goal above — no need to repeat it. Fill this in only to split that area further, e.g. 5 Values, 7 Habits, DEAR.
wig.wigTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Increase homework submitted on time
wig.wigTitleHint: State it the 4DX way: what improves, from where to where
wig.weekdaysHint: Empty = Mon–Fri. For work done at home on the weekend, add Sat/Sun.
wig.tickBoardSilent: {n} students have not ticked at all
wig.noWeekWigsThisWeek: No weekly WIG for {label} — so students have no shared work to tick.
wig.unitPerTickHint: In the goal's unit ({unit}). Leave it at 1 when one tick means one {unit}; set 30 when the goal is in minutes and each session is 30 minutes.
wig.warnTooMany: Each student needs {can} ticks, but the week only has {ngay} tickable days ({co} ticks) — nobody can reach it. Lower the target, add more weekdays, or set “each tick counts as” correctly.
wig.warnUnitMismatch: Measured in “{lead}” while the goal is in “{wig}” — different units, yet each tick still adds 1 {wig} to progress. Either make both use the same unit, or set “each tick counts as” to how many {wig} ONE session is really worth (not the number in the task name).
wig.needYearFirst: You need a YEAR goal first.
wig.needMonthFirst: You need a MONTH goal first.
wig.chainYear: The big goal for the school year. Every month and week goal hangs under it, and the year progress is their sum.
wig.chainMonth: The middle leg: one month of the year goal. You need one before you can set week goals.
wig.chainWeek: One week of work. This is where students tick — it adds up into the month, then into the year.
wig.addWorkNeedsWig: No week goal yet, so there is nothing to attach a task to.
wig.studentListEmpty: No students in this class yet.
wig.emptyWeek: no goal for this week yet
wig.noWeekWigsHow: Create a year goal, then a month goal, then a week goal from “New goal” at the top right.
wig.noWeekWigsHowMeeting: Set the week goal inside the WIG meeting room below — or use “New goal” at the top right.
wig.meetingTime: Time for the weekly WIG meeting
wig.meetingWhat: Close out week {truoc} · reflect · set the goal for week {sau} — all in one sitting.
wig.detailEmpty: No shared tasks for the class this week.
wig.detailEmptyHow: Set a week goal and add tasks on the WIG page; students will see them right away and can tick.
wig.detailLegend: A gold box means the student ticked that day. A dashed box is an applicable day left empty. Days not yet reached are faded; days the task does not apply to show no box at all.
wig.detailDenominator: The denominator counts only days that have PASSED — nobody is marked down for a day that has not arrived. Tap a name to open their page.
wig.csNeedClassYear: The class has no yearly goal yet. Each student’s goal is derived from it, so set the class yearly goals first.
wig.measureManual: Recorded by teacher, mark when achieved

meeting.title: Weekly WIG meeting
meeting.lessonPlaceholder: Why did it work or not? What will we do differently next week?
meeting.noPromiseLastWeek: No commitment was recorded last week. After today’s meeting, the step-2 commitment will show here next week.
meeting.viewNewWeekGoal: View the new goal for week {week}
meeting.step1: What the class did in week {week}
meeting.step1Hint: {range} · these numbers are counted from the students’ own ticks and cannot be edited here.
meeting.step2Hint: What last week taught you, and what the class promises each other for next week.
meeting.step3Hint: {range} · filling this in creates the new week goal — no need to go back to the WIG page.
meeting.noWorkThatWeek: The class had no shared tasks in week {week}.
meeting.reflectionPlaceholder: What went well last week, and what did not?
meeting.commitmentsHint: One sentence the class promises each other for next week. It appears at the top of next week’s meeting.
meeting.commitmentsPlaceholder: e.g. This week everyone reads on all 5 evenings, nobody skips.
meeting.goalEditThere: Edit it on the WIG page
meeting.needYearWig: The class has no year goal yet, so a week goal cannot be set.
meeting.goToWig: Go to the WIG page to create one
meeting.milestoneMissing: Week {week} has no milestone — the year goal was set after this week began. Add one here without leaving the meeting.
meeting.carriedOver: Carried over from last week. The steadier a lead measure, the more it tells you — edit or remove as you like.
meeting.finishHint: Closing saves everything you filled in and locks ticks and readings for week {week}.
meeting.readOnlyNotice: Read-only view for school leadership: how the class closed out last week. Scoring and goal-setting belong to the homeroom teacher.
meeting.undoHint: Reviewed the wrong week? Undoing week {week} reopens ticking for that week.
meeting.confirmUndo: Remove all scoring and minutes for week {week}? Ticking for that week reopens. This cannot be undone.
meeting.noWeekData: No WIG data for this week yet.
meeting.paceWarn: This week needs {can}, but the actions only allow {cho} — short by {thieu}. Raise the action target, or lower the week milestone to match.
meeting.closedHint: Week {week} is closed. Ticks and readings are locked — remove the minutes at the bottom to reopen.
meeting.thisWeekWork: What will you do this week

report.title: Parent report
report.noChild: Your account is not linked to any student. Please contact an administrator.
report.attendance: Attendance — running total for the school year
report.wigProgress: How your child is doing this year
report.noWeeks: Your child has no weekly goals yet. The homeroom teacher sets them with the class.
report.weekResult: What your child did that week
report.noMeeting: No notes from a meeting this week.
report.noWeekData: No personal goal for your child this week yet.
report.attendanceNote: These four numbers cover the whole school year; they do not change with the week you pick above.

student.title: My achievement board
student.notFound: Student not found or you don't have access.
student.moodHint: Color follows personal WIG progress — greener means happier.
student.moodRequired: Check in to continue — this also marks today's attendance.
student.planHint: What you enter here creates the real weekly WIG and lead measures for next week — the student can tick them right away, no need to re-enter on the WIG page.
student.planNoYearWig: This student has no yearly WIG yet, so weekly WIGs can't be created. Set the yearly WIG in the block above first.
student.buddyTodayMood: Today's action: check in your mood.
student.buddyTodayAsk: Today's action: ask your teacher to review this week's target.
student.buddyChatClosed: Buddy is closed. Ask your teacher to open it during the meeting.
student.buddyChatLimit: No turns left in this meeting.
student.buddyChatTooLong: That message is too long, please shorten it.
student.buddyChatPlaceholder: Ask Buddy about this week's goals…
student.buddyChatNotice: Buddy only talks about this week's goals. Don't share personal details — your teacher can read this whole conversation.
student.buddyErrNoWig: You have not set a goal yet, so Buddy has nothing to look at. Scroll up to “My goal” to set one.
student.buddyErrNoClass: You're not enrolled in a class yet, so Buddy can't help.
student.buddyErrRateLimited: Buddy already wrote to you today — come back tomorrow.
student.buddyErrNoKey: Buddy isn't enabled yet. Ask the school to configure it.
student.buddyErrGeneric: Buddy is unavailable, please try again later.
student.requestRenameTitle: Ask your teacher to rename this item to match what you actually do
student.tickWeekLocked: The class has closed out this week, so ticks are final. If something is wrong, ask your homeroom teacher to fix it.
student.requestPh_add_tick: Say which date, e.g. I did it on 25/07 but forgot to tick.
student.requestPh_rename_lead: The new name you want, e.g. Math tutoring session.
student.requestPh_change_target: Target you want and why, e.g. 3 per week because I have 2 extra classes.
student.requestPendingHint: Your teacher hasn't handled it yet, so you can still edit the note or withdraw it.
student.moodBlocked: You can only check in at school (on the school wifi network).
student.moodNoClass: You are not enrolled in any class yet — please tell your teacher.
student.moodError: Could not submit, please try again.

moodMsg.good: You're on the right track, a little more!
moodMsg.ok: Nice! A few more stars and you'll be amazing.
moodMsg.low: Don't worry, let's do better together this week!
moodMsg.bad: It's okay! Every little star helps you move up.

student.noWig: Your homeroom teacher hasn't set personal WIGs yet.
student.undoError: Could not untick — usually because the class has already closed out this week. Ask your homeroom teacher.
student.lockedNote: During the week you can tick and untick freely. Whichever week the class reviews gets locked; after that ask your teacher.
student.meetingHint: The homeroom teacher (Coach) records weekly WIG meeting notes with the student and their buddy.
student.confirmDeleteMeeting: Delete these minutes? Cannot be undone.
student.requestEditTitle: Send an edit request to the teacher
student.requestEditPlaceholder: e.g. I ticked by mistake yesterday, please remove it…
student.remaining: {n} more for the class to win
student.streakHint: Days in a row you have ticked
student.moodClosed: Outside check-in hours. Mornings 6:30–8:00, afternoons from 16:00.
student.moodLocked: Locked — the morning mood can only be changed before 7:00.
student.luongQuaLon: One day cannot exceed the whole week's target ({n}).

campusReport.title: Campus report
campusReport.subjectsCardHint: Browse the school subject catalogue, add campus-only subjects, and pick who teaches what in each class.
campusReport.noClasses: No classes in this campus yet.
campusReport.noCampusAssigned: Your account is not assigned to a campus yet, so there is no data to show. Ask an admin to open Admin → Users and pick a campus for you. This does NOT mean the school has no classes.
campusReport.inviteTeacherHint: ⚠ The app does NOT send invitation emails. Tell the invited person to sign in at class.vietanh.org with Google — their role and class are assigned on first sign-in.
campusReport.noTeacher: No teachers in this campus yet
campusReport.confirmDisable: Disable this teacher? They lose access, but everything they recorded is kept.
campusReport.wigHint: Won = the class hit its weekly target, counted from real student ticks.
campusReport.wigNoData: No class in your scope has set a weekly WIG for this week.
campusReport.wigIdleTick: This class has no goal for the week, so students have nothing to tick.
campusReport.noWigYet: This class has no year goal yet — not started, not losing.

scoreboard.title: Competition by area
scoreboard.hint: This is the TOTAL NUMBER OF ACTIONS students have completed, added up from the start and not split by week. It is NOT the same as “Competition score” on the home page — that one is the percentage of the year goal, running 0 to 100.
scoreboard.emptyHow: This board adds up the students’ own ticks. Once the class has a week goal with tasks to tick, students tick them and this number grows on its own — teachers enter nothing.
scoreboard.emptyGo: Go to WIG and set a week goal

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.noSubjects: This class has no subjects yet, so there is nothing to pick for a timetable slot. Press the button beside this to add the campus subject set to the class, then schedule as usual.
timetable.subject: Subject
timetable.hint: Pick day + period, enter subject (and room), then Save. Re-entering the same cell overwrites it.
timetable.editHint: Editing this slot — day and period are locked. To move it to another period, use “Per-day schedule changes” below.
timetable.ovHint: Use this when one specific day differs from the usual schedule: cancelled, moved to another period, or covered by a substitute. The weekly template above stays unchanged — only that day changes.
timetable.slotPopupHint: This cell repeats EVERY WEEK. To change one session only — cancel, move, substitute — use “Per-day changes” below.
timetable.repeatNote: The grid below is a fixed timetable — set it once and it repeats every week. The week selector only shows real dates and marks changes to a single session (cancelled, moved, substitute).
timetable.confirmDeleteSlot: Delete {subject} — {day}, period {period}? This removes it from EVERY week, for the class and for parents. This cannot be undone.

subjects.title: Subjects & teaching assignments
subjects.noCampus: Your account is not linked to a campus yet, so you cannot add campus-only subjects. Ask an administrator to assign your campus first.
subjects.noClassForAssign: There is no class in your scope to assign subject teachers to.
subjects.createSharedTitle: Add a subject shared across the school
subjects.createHint: Untick “graded with scores” for subjects assessed by comments (PE, Music, Art, Experiential learning…). The subject code is machine-readable and cannot be changed later — the display name can be edited any time.
subjects.createHintOwn: A campus-only subject can be picked by classes of your campus only; if its name clashes with a shared subject, the system will say so and you should use the shared one.
subjects.chipOwnTitle: A subject belonging to one campus only
subjects.chipReviewTitle: Assessed by comments, not by scores
subjects.gradesUndeclared: ⚠ grades not set · selectable by every class
subjects.confirmOff: Turn off "{name}"? It will disappear from every picker from now on. Existing scores are kept and stay readable.
subjects.noDeleteHint: Subjects are never deleted, only turned off. Every score already entered points at a subject in this list: deleting one would break old report cards, while turning it off removes it from the pickers and keeps old scores fully readable.
subjects.noDeleteHintPrincipal: School-wide subjects and the grade list of each subject are managed by administrators — you can edit subjects belonging to your own campus.
subjects.pickGrades: Pick the grades that take this subject
subjects.gradesHint: Ticking nothing means NOT SET, and a subject that is not set can be picked by every grade. That is how the system avoids blocking you by mistake, not a bug — but setting it correctly keeps each class subject picker short.
subjects.allAssigned: Every teacher is already assigned to this subject
subjects.pickTeacherAria: Pick a teacher for {subject} in class {class}
subjects.seedSubjects: Add the standard subjects to this class
subjects.noSubjectsTitle: Class {class} has no subjects yet, so nobody can be assigned.
subjects.noSubjectsHint: Press “Add the standard subjects to this class” above: the system adds every subject in use at this campus to the class programme in one go. After that you can pick who teaches what.
subjects.nobodyTeaches: nobody yet — no one can enter scores for this subject
subjects.confirmUnassign:
Remove {teacher} from {subject} in class {class}?

Immediately after removal this teacher can NO LONGER enter or edit {subject} scores for the class. Scores already entered are kept, and the assignment record is retained so you can look up who taught what.
subjects.noTeacherAccounts: There are no teacher accounts to pick from
subjects.subjectOffHint: Turn the subject back on in the table above before assigning
subjects.assignHint: Adding a teacher here GRANTS the right to enter scores for that subject in this class, effective immediately. Pressing ✕ revokes it: the teacher instantly loses the right to enter and edit scores for that subject. The record is not deleted — you can still look up who taught what, where.

gallery.title: Class photos · {class}
gallery.confirmDeleteAlbum: Delete the album “{title}” together with all {n} photos inside? This cannot be undone.
gallery.confirmDeletePhoto: Remove this photo from the album?
gallery.emptyAlbumManage: This album has no photos yet. Press “Pick photos” above to upload.
gallery.emptyAlbum: This album has no photos yet.
gallery.noAlbumsManage: The class has no albums yet. Create the first one in the box above.
gallery.noAlbums: The class has no photo albums yet.
gallery.privacyManage: Photos here are visible only to students of the class, parents with a child in the class, and campus leadership — nobody outside the school can open them. Even so, a screen can always be captured, so think twice before posting close-up faces.
gallery.privacyPrincipal: You can view photos of the classes at your campus. Posting and deleting photos belongs to the homeroom teacher.
gallery.privacyFamily: Photos are posted by the homeroom teacher. These belong to the class — please do not share them outside.
gallery.phDesc: A few lines telling parents what the class did that day
gallery.dateHint: The event date is the day it actually happened, not today — parents look for photos by event date.
gallery.hCaption: Optional. Also used as the image description for screen-reader users.
gallery.pickPhotosAria: Pick photos to upload to the album
gallery.uploadHint: You can pick several photos at once. Up to 10 MB each, in JPG / PNG / WEBP / HEIC. Photos are visible only to students of the class, parents with a child in the class, and campus leadership.
gallery.errSave: {file} (could not be saved to the album)

menu.title: Meal menu
menu.noCampus: We could not work out your campus, so the menu cannot be shown. Ask an administrator to link your account to a campus, or check whether your child has been placed in a class.
menu.intro: The menu is set per CAMPUS, not per class — the whole school eats the same menu, so it only needs entering once a day.
menu.introManage: Press “Edit” in a cell to load its contents into the compose box below.
menu.introView: If a meal is missing, ask the office to update it.
menu.hNote: Last-minute swaps, vegetarian alternatives, allergy warnings…
menu.hDishes: One dish per line — parents read it line by line.
menu.phDishes:
Steamed rice
Pork and cabbage soup
Braised pork with egg
Watermelon
menu.saveHint: Saving a meal that already exists OVERWRITES the previous contents of that exact day and meal; it does not add another row.
menu.todayEmpty: The school has not posted today’s menu yet.

inbox.cannotOpenHint: The link may be out of date, or the conversation does not belong to you.
inbox.noMessagesYet: No messages yet. Write the first one.
inbox.lockedLeftClass: This conversation is locked because the student no longer studies in this class. Both sides can still read everything already written.
inbox.privacyThread: Only you and the homeroom teacher can read this. School leadership and administrators cannot.
inbox.noLinkHint: Your account is not linked to any student yet, so there is no conversation to open.
inbox.emptyParent: No conversations yet. Open one to message the homeroom teacher.
inbox.emptyTeacher: No parent has messaged you yet. You can also reach out first.
inbox.openLabelParent: Open a new conversation about your child
inbox.openLabelTeacher: Open a conversation with a student’s family
inbox.openHintParent: One conversation per child, used all year — you do not need to open a new one for each message.
inbox.openHintTeacher: Only students with NO conversation yet are listed. Once opened, their parents get a notification.
inbox.privacyFootParent: Only you and the homeroom teacher can read these messages. School leadership and administrators cannot.
inbox.privacyFootTeacher: Only you and the student’s family can read these messages. School leadership sees only how many conversations await a reply, never the contents.
inbox.phParent: For example: He has been going to bed late lately — could you see if he seems tired in class?
inbox.phTeacher: For example: She worked on her own initiative today — please do praise her at home.
inbox.waitingTeacher: Waiting for the teacher to reply
inbox.healthTitle: Parent messages — which classes are keeping parents waiting
inbox.healthEmpty: No class has messaged parents this school year yet.
inbox.healthFoot: These are follow-up figures only. The system does not let school leadership or administrators read the contents of family conversations.

homework.title: Homework board · {class}

kindOptions.assignment: Assignment (something to do or hand in)

homework.noteStudent: The “I have done it” box is for you to keep track of your own work — it is not a mark, and it is never used for ranking or comparing you with classmates. Only you, your homeroom teacher and your parents can see it; other students cannot.
homework.noteParent: This is your child’s class homework board. The “done” mark is set by the child to track their own work, not a grade — so you can see it but cannot mark it on their behalf.
homework.notePrincipal: You are viewing the class homework board. Posting and editing belongs to the homeroom teacher.
homework.noSubjects: This class has no subjects yet, so there is nothing to pick when posting. Press the button beside this to add the campus standard subject set to the class.
homework.emptyManage: The class has no posts yet. Use the box above to post the first one.
homework.empty: The class has no posts yet.
homework.hDue: Leave empty if nothing has to be handed in
homework.phContent: e.g. Do exercises 3 and 4 on page 52 of the workbook. Anyone who has not finished yesterday’s work should finish it too.
homework.postHint: Once posted, students and parents of the class see it immediately. If you post by mistake you can edit or delete it in the list below.

grades.askLeadershipTerm: Ask school leadership to create the semester first, then teachers can enter scores.
grades.confirmReopen: Reopen the period "{name}"? The homeroom teacher will be able to edit scores and comments again.
grades.confirmLock: Close the period "{name}"? After closing, teachers can no longer edit scores or comments for it.
grades.subjectTeacherNone: You are not assigned to teach any subject in class {class}
grades.askAssignment: Ask school leadership to assign you a subject in this class first, then you can enter scores. Only leadership and administrators can assign — not even the homeroom teacher can self-assign.
grades.seedHint: The class programme is the only source for the subject picker when entering scores. Press the button below to attach the whole set of subjects in use at this campus — ask an administrator to remove any extras afterwards.
grades.seedButton: Add the standard subject set to this class
grades.lockedNotice: This period is closed — scores and comments can no longer be edited. Ask school leadership to reopen it if you need to change something.
grades.noSheetsManage: The class has no sheets for this period yet. Press “Open the period for the whole class” above to create a sheet for every student at once, then you can enter scores.
grades.noSheets: The homeroom teacher has not opened this assessment period for the class yet.
grades.pickColumn: Pick the score column to enter
grades.noSubjectsSeed: This class has no subjects yet — add the standard set above, or ask an administrator to attach subjects to the class.
grades.pickSubjectFirst: Pick a subject above to start entering scores.
grades.publishHint: Before publishing, everything here is a DRAFT — visible only to teachers and school leadership.
grades.confirmPublish: Publish {n} sheets of the period "{name}"? FAMILIES WILL IMMEDIATELY SEE the scores, comments and conduct — please check them over first.
grades.confirmUnpublish: Unpublish {n} sheets? Families will no longer be able to see them. This is recorded in the system audit log. To fix a few words you do NOT need to unpublish — just edit and save, and families see the new version.
grades.nothingToPublish: There is nothing to publish yet.
grades.noScoresYet: No scores in this period yet — the table appears as soon as a teacher saves the first score column.
grades.missingSheetsManage: — press “Open the period for the whole class” above to add them.
grades.missingSheets: — ask the homeroom teacher to open the period for those students; without a sheet no score can be entered.
grades.columnHint: This list is the class programme. If a subject is missing, ask an administrator to add it to the catalogue and attach it to the class.
grades.leftClassTitle: This student left the class mid-period. The sheet and existing scores are kept, but comments and conduct can no longer be edited and nothing further can be published.
grades.noSheetsInTerm: The class has no sheets for this period yet.
grades.noChildLinked: This account is not linked to any student. Please ask the homeroom teacher to check.
grades.nothingPublished: No report card has been published yet. Once the school finishes a period, it will appear here.
grades.noScoresInTerm: No scores in this period yet.
grades.noConductInTerm: No conduct rating in this period yet.
grades.noCommentInTerm: No comment in this period yet.
grades.reviewHint: Comments here go straight to the family once published — parents and the student read them word for word. Do not use this box for internal notes.
grades.publishedTitle: This student’s sheet is published — the family can see it
grades.commentPlaceholder: Has improved at… still needs to work on…
grades.conductScoreAria: Conduct score for {name} (out of 100, may be left empty)
grades.columnFormHint: Enter from top to bottom then press Save once. An empty box means that student’s score is removed.
grades.hTermName: Leave empty to use the period type name.
grades.termCreateHint: A newly created period is shared by every class of the campus. The homeroom teacher then opens it for their own class before scores can be entered.
grades.enterForClass: Enter scores for the whole class · {column}
grades.noTermForLeader: Report cards are organised by ASSESSMENT PERIOD (mid-term 1, end of term 1, mid-term 2, end of term 2, full year). Until one exists, teachers have nowhere to enter marks, so there is nothing to read here. Create one below — each campus does this once per school year and every class shares it.

goal.title: My goal
goal.hint: No goal yet. Tap “Set a goal” — three questions and you're done.
goal.openFormFor: Set a goal for this student
goal.confirmDelete: Delete this goal? The ticks recorded under it go too.
goal.confirmDeleteFor: Delete {ten}'s goal? The ticks recorded under it go too.
goal.lockedHint: This goal is locked in (more than a day old). Ask your teacher to change it.
goal.step1: ① What do you want to get better at?
goal.step2: ② From where to where, and by when?
goal.step3: ③ What will you do this week?
goal.joinBattle: Which class goal does this help with?
goal.workPlaceholder: e.g. redo every question I got wrong
goal.whichDays: Which days will you do it?
goal.wallEmpty: No goals yet. Students can set one from My scoreboard.
goal.selfSetRate: {n}% of goals were set by the students themselves
goal.journalHint: How did this week go? Only you can write here; your teacher and parents can read it.
goal.journalPlaceholder: e.g. I worked more steadily this week, but I forgot on Friday…
goal.noClassWig: Your class has no yearly goals yet. Ask your teacher to add one first.
goal.previewEmpty: Fill in the three steps above and your goal sentence will appear here.
goal.journalReset: Monday starts a fresh page. This week's note is kept — open “Earlier weeks” to read it again.
goal.step1Personal: ① What do you want to get better at, just for yourself?
goal.openFormPersonal: I want to add a goal of my own
goal.openFormPersonalFor: Add a personal goal for this student
goal.paceTooEasy: At {n} times a week you finish in {can} weeks but have {con} — aim higher?
goal.paceTooHard: At {n} times a week you need {can} weeks but only have {con}.
goal.unitMeasured: “{unit}” is re-measured, not added up — you'll enter it on your goal card once a week.
goal.eachTimeVaries: It varies — I'll type the number each day
